text:
Mira (PM): Heads-up: enterprise pilot inbound (codename: Granite Bridge). Customer needs private deploy option + strict SLA. need to map dependencies and get rough timeline. short sync in thread pls.
Tom (Runtime): I'll own runtime readiness. immediate asks: model ver pin, config for KV cache warmup, and a fallback route to hosted endpoint. also want perf target: p95 < 200ms for <256-token requests.
Harpreet (Infra): Infra flagged: private VPC peering, dedicated staging cluster (4xV100 equiv), encrypted audit sink to SIEM, and DLP hook. estimate 3 infra sprints (staging + production).
Zoe (Security): security requirements: SOC2 scoping, DPA review, data residency note (customer requires US-only), and cert for HSM usage. will need design doc and threat model. can do review within 7 business days after doc.
Mateo (SRE): need expected throughput. can we get target RPS and burst rate? that'll drive prewarm and autoscale policies. also pipeline for synthetic load during canary.
Mira (PM): target baseline 120 rps sustained, burst 400rps, 99.9% availability target for pilot window, cost cap per 1M tokens: $X (negotiable).
Tom (Runtime): with 120sust/400burst we'll likely need continuous batching tuned + prewarmed KV shards. request access to model artifact repo and quantization knobs. estimate dev work: 6 story pts.
Harpreet (Infra): ok. can provision staging cluster for perf tests if we get dates. need exact AMI, container image tag, and mount points. I'll open INF-4410.
Zoe (Security): DPA + SOC2 doorway: legal needs time. can we align pilot start to allow 2-week legal review? otherwise we do limited-data pilot with anonymized telemetry.
Claire (Prod Ops): rollout plan suggestion: feature flag + 3-stage canary: 1% (2h), 10% (12h), 100% (24h). monitor: latency p95, error rate, and hallucination metric from eval set. owner for each gate required.
Mateo (SRE): add automatic rollback rule: if p95 > 300ms for 15m OR error rate > 1.5% then switch traffic to hosted fallback and page oncall. who owns rollback automation?
Tom (Runtime): I'll implement the fallback toggle and the metric hooks. need runbook for SRE to trigger manual rollback too.
Harpreet (Infra): note: customer also asked for key separation per-tenant. that'll impact KMS design. opening INF-4411 for KMS design.
Zoe (Security): KMS per-tenant is fine, but we require key-rotation policy + access audit. also plan a pen test in the pilot window.
Mira (PM): draft acceptance criteria so we can sign off:
- Legal/DPA: executed or approved limited-data exception
- Security threat model completed: required
- Infra: staging cluster + VPC peering + KMS keys provisioned
- Runtime perf: perf harness p95 <= 200ms on target workload
- Canary gates automated with owners assigned
- Rollback automation and runbook present
Claire (Prod Ops): will own canary orchestration and dashboard. I'll create dashboard template and a shared doc with gates.
Tom (Runtime): I'll push a perf harness PR and a small quantization parity test. if quantized model delta > 2% quality we keep unquant path for pilot.
Harpreet (Infra): timeline ask: earliest we can do perf window is next Wed 01:00-04:00 UTC. does that work for runtime?
Tom (Runtime): that's fine. pls allocate 6 GPU-hours. I'll validate and post perf results.
Zoe (Security): before perf, redact PII from prompts. Claire, please confirm eval artifacts are sanitized.
Claire (Prod Ops): yes, we'll use synthetic + scrubbed customer prompts. storing artifacts encrypted in S3 with limited access.
Mateo (SRE): oncall rota: nominate two responders for pilot days. also propose a quick escalation ladder: runtime -> infra -> security contact.
Mira (PM): owners: Tom (runtime), Harpreet (infra), Zoe (security), Claire (prodops), Mateo (sre). timeline: draft 1-pager by EOD Fri, perf window Wed, review sync next Thu 09:30 PT.
ops-bot: scheduled: perf-window -> Wed 01:30 UTC (6 GPU-hours) (id: perf-176222).
Tom (Runtime): I'll add runtime tasks to the board with estimates (6 pts runtime infra integration, 2 pts fallback).
Harpreet (Infra): creating INF-4410, INF-4411. tagging network and ops teams.
Zoe (Security): putting a calendar invite for threat model review. will attach template.
Claire (Prod Ops): adding canary metric set: p95_latency, error_rate, quality_score_delta, cost_delta. will own dashboard.
Mateo (SRE): I'll prepare the rollback script and a short postmortem template for the pilot.
Mira (PM): one more ask: customer asked about SLA for latency. legal needs us to avoid firm contractual SLA until pilot proves perf. we'll offer a service level objective in the statement of work.
Tom (Runtime): noted. we'll aim to meet SLO but flag risk if perf deviates during test.
Mira (PM): ok great. if there are blockers post-1-pager, ping #product-handshake and we'll triage. thanks everyone :rocket:
